preconditions: Typed landform evidence when artificial or coastal origin is asserted
requiredEvidence: DEM profile; optional GSI landform classification polygons
decisionLogic: Rank scale-relative DEM shape metrics and route-majority typed landform evidence; artificial evidence takes precedence only at its sampled station.
uncertainty: Route- and scale-dependent morphological hypothesis; not a geological-cause classifier
exclusions: Must not choose a geological domain
Must not authorize a fault, fan, buried valley, terrace, landslide, reclamation thickness or other subsurface event
Must not infer artificial or coastal origin from a flat DEM alone
validationMethod: Positive, negative, boundary, mixed-evidence and out-of-scope unit tests plus six synthetic terrain profiles
reopenCondition: GSI code table or tile schema changes; a 2D terrain-window classifier replaces route-only evidence; calibrated thresholds become available
